# VortexApps

VortexApps is a high-performance software development team based in Patna, India. We build AI integrations, scalable web applications, and real-time software systems.

## Services Offered
- **AI Engineering & Integration**: Developing custom machine learning workflows, embedding Google Gemini models, and designing secure LLM pipelines.
- **Full-Stack Engineering**: Building responsive frontends (React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS) and scalable backend systems (Node.js, Python, REST APIs).
- **Product Architecture**: Designing low-latency system design, relational/non-relational database structures, and cost-effective cloud deployments.

## Live Projects
- **BeatWave**: A premium, open-source audio streaming player built with React and Node for zero-advertisement delivery. [beatwave.de5.net](https://beatwave.de5.net)
- **WaveMirror**: A search aggregator featuring instant query results, movie reviews, and metadata visualization. [wavemirror.vercel.app](https://wavemirror.vercel.app)
- **Onyx Chat**: A low-latency websocket messaging system with real-time database synchronization. [onyxchat.de5.net](https://onyxchat.de5.net)
